prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [val2][反例] 行标题长于数据 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "考核指标" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 278px
  col 2: header "权重" · longest unbreakable word 36px · one-line width 36px
  col 3: header "目标值" · longest unbreakable word 36px · one-line width 53px
  col 4: header "实际值" · longest unbreakable word 50px · one-line width 54px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 458px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 457px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示各项绩效考核指标的权重，并比较目标值与实际值。","reading":"读者先按左侧指标定位行，再横向查看权重、目标值和实际值；也会纵向浏览各项权重和目标完成情况。","groups":["目标值与实际值是一组需要逐行比较的数据，宽度和视觉节奏宜接近。","权重也是数值列，但内容较短，可比目标值和实际值窄。","考核指标是行标题，文字明显更长，需要承担主要的换行。"],"keep_intact":["百分比、金额及其他数值连同单位和符号尽量保持在同一行。","列标题保持完整，尤其是目标值和实际值。"],"may_wrap":["考核指标可在中文词语或括号附近自然换行；较长指标形成的行高可容纳同一行其他单元格。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [240, 57, 80, 80] · table 458×250px · row heights [39, 66, 66, 39, 39] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [255, 57, 74, 71] · table 458×277px · row heights [66, 66, 66, 39, 39] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"四个表头和各项数值均保持完整；目标值与实际值等宽，便于逐行比较。指标列承担换行，后两行紧凑，整体层次清楚。","problems":"前两项指标均换成两行，括号中的说明被拆开；第一项末尾的“协议）”和第二项末尾的“额加权）”落在下一行，阅读节奏略显零碎。","cause":"指标列宽240px，扣除21px后文本空间为219px，不足以容纳这些较长指标；两个数据列各80px，略宽于其完整显示内容所需的宽度。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"指标列加宽到255px，给长行标题更多空间；权重和目标值仍保持完整。","problems":"实际值表头和首行“2.61 亿”都换行，削弱了目标值与实际值的比较节奏，也使表头行和首个数据行显得过高。两个长指标仍然需要换行，额外宽度未消除这些换行。","cause":"实际值列宽71px，扣除21px后仅有50px文本空间，小于该列54px的一行内容宽度；其表头也因可用空间不足而折行。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-75","widths":[250,57,75,75],"change":"将目标值与实际值都设为75px，恰好容纳各自最长的一行内容；把节省的空间分给指标列，同时保持比较列等宽。"},{"name":"row-label-252","widths":[252,57,74,74],"change":"目标值列保留其所需的74px，实际值列也设为74px以维持对称；指标列进一步加宽，用于检验长指标的换行是否更自然。实际值最长内容可能仍会折行，需通过渲染确认。"},{"name":"content-fit","widths":[251,57,74,75],"change":"按内容所需的最小一行宽度分别给目标值74px、实际值75px，余下251px分给指标列，检验不等宽1px时的整体节奏与换行。"}]}
